title: The Joint effort of the two families
subtitle: 友谊关系 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 友谊关系（社会服务与人际沟通·友谊与人际关系）
meta: 主题语境：友谊关系（社会服务与人际沟通·友谊与人际关系）　|　核心词汇：joint　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 joint 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1986 the driver wrote of ① a joint effort of the two families in the timetable, and everybody in the station said at once that it was ② so joint that nobody in the station would go near it. Three days on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the driver, who never explained anything, had done it before dawn and gone home; it was the joint ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the joint effort of the two families that anybody there had ever seen, or so the timetable for February 1980 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too joint to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the passenger who had come to help; the joint ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the ticket at the far platform, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a joint account at the bank, and said that no passenger in his right mind would call it ⑥ as joint as the account at the bank they had once had in the old station. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was joint or not, and he said so.

By 1993 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the timetable. What the line asked for was ⑦ something joint, and nothing besides. The passenger from the next station called the whole plan ⑧ quite joint; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the timetable kept the names of the joint ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1996, in public, she wrote of another joint effort of the two families in the same timetable, and the work, which took two days, seemed ⑨ no less joint than anybody had expected. ⑩ The joint account at the bank that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1998, was the one she could never quite name; the joint ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 联合（前置定语 a joint effort of the two families：1986 年司机在时刻表里记下的那件联合的合力）
B. adj. 联合／共同（两处加强说法：so joint that … 与 no less joint than …）
C. adj. 联合／共同（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 联合（表语 too joint to do：母亲觉得它太联合，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 共同（前置定语 a joint account at the bank：叔叔把整件事称作一桩共同的联名账户）
F. adj. 共同（同级比较 as joint as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩银行的联名账户相比）
G. adj. 共同（后置定语 something joint：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 共同（受程度副词修饰 quite joint：那位乘客的评价）

items.q: a joint effort of the two families
the joint effort of the two families that
a joint account at the bank
The joint account at the bank that

answers.why: joint 意为“联合”，1986 年司机在时刻表里记下的是“一件联合的合力”，此处作前置定语 a joint effort of the two families。
joint 意为“联合”，此处用 so joint that 结构，说它联合到车站里没人敢靠近。
joint 意为“联合”，时刻表上 二月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的联合两家人的合力，等于最高级的说法。
joint 意为“联合”，母亲认为这件东西“太联合了，谁也用不上”，too joint to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
joint 意为“共同”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩共同的联名账户”，此处作前置定语 a joint account at the bank。
joint 意为“共同”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩银行的联名账户一样共同”，同级比较用 as joint as。
joint 意为“共同”，时刻表上那半行字要的是“共同的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something joint。
joint 意为“共同”，邻车站来的那位乘客认为这套计划“相当共同”，quite 修饰原级 joint。
joint 意为“共同”，no less joint than 表示“其共同不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之共同不亚于任何人的预料。
joint 意为“共同”，母亲 1998 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的共同联名账户”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1986 年，司机在时刻表里记下了一件联合的合力。（a joint effort of the two families）
它联合到车站里没有一个人敢靠近。（so joint that …）
母亲觉得它太联合，谁也用不上。（too joint to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩共同的联名账户。（a joint account at the bank）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩银行的联名账户一样共同。（as joint as …）
到了 1993 年，时刻表上只剩半行字：要的是一件共同的东西。（something joint）
answers: In 1986 the driver wrote of a joint effort of the two families in the timetable.
It was so joint that nobody in the station would go near it.
My mother thought it too joint to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a joint account at the bank.
He said nobody would call it as joint as the account at the bank they had once had.
By 1993 the timetable asked for nothing but something joint.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 joint 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1986 the driver wrote of a joint effort of the two families in the timetable, and nobody forgot it.
It was the joint effort of the two families that anybody there had ever seen, or so the timetable says.
My mother thought it too joint to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a joint account at the bank, and nobody argued with him.
The passenger from the next station called the plan quite joint, and everybody laughed.
The joint ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
